s: Din nosee hammitta vehamnachamim vehamlavvin ubo h' seipim: nosee hammitta vechillupehem vechillupe chillupehem, ben otam shellipne hammitta ben otam shelleachareha, meachar sheyyesh lammitta tzorek bahem laset otah, kegon beir sheyyesh bah chabura hamzummenet lekak, vekol bene hachabura machalipin laset lepi shekkullam chapetzim lizkot bo — kullam peturim miqqeriat shema (lepi shehem terudim tirdat mitzva). Abal shear hamlavvin et hammet sheen lammitta tzorek bahen — chayyabim biqriat shema (veap al pi shehalvayat hammet hu biklal gemilut chesed, ugemilut chesed hu min hattora, mikkol maqom hem enam terudim kelal vikolin liqrot pasuq rishon bekavvana ubaamida vehashshear keshehem mehallekin), abal peturim mehattepilla kemo sheyyitbaer besiman q"v:

En motziin et hammet samuk lehatchalat zeman qeriat shema, bainyan sheen shehut lehotzio uleqobro qodem sheyyaggia zeman qeriat shema, shemma yitakkebu biqburato ad sheyyaabor zemannah. Veim hitchilu lehotzio (apillu leachar shehiggia zeman qeriat shema) — en mapsiqin kede liqrot, ella otam sheen lammitta tzorek bahem bilbad. Bammeh debarim amurim? Biqriat shema shel shacharit, abal samuk lizman qeriat shema shel arbit — muttar lehotzio ap al pi sheen shehut leqobro qodem zeman qeriat shema, lepi sheim lo yiqberennu hayyom — yaabor al "lo talin" (veap im yukal ballayla leqobro — yaabor al mitzvat aseh "ki qabor tiqberennu bayyom hahu" im lo yiqberennu qodem sheqiat hachamma). Umikkol maqom im hu mippelag hammincha ulemala sheyyesh omerim shehu zeman qeriat shema kemo sheyyitbaer besiman rl"h — tob lachush ledibrehem veliqrot qeriat shema techilla uleqobro achar kak (kevan sherob haolam nohagim kisbara zo, ap al pi shehaiqqar kedibre hacholaqim kemo sheyyitbaer sham):

Haam haoseqim behesped bizman shehammet muttal lipnehem — nishmatin echad echad veqorin umitpalelim, shei epshar sheyyiqreu kullam kan etzel hammet mishshum "loeg larash". En hammet muttal lipnehem ella bebayit acher — hem qorein umitpalelin, vehaonen yosheb vedomem veen oneh acharehem kelum, mittaam shennitbaer besiman a"a:

Qaberu et hammet vechazeru haabelim leqabbel tanchumin vekol haam holekim acharehem mimmeqom haqqeber lammaqom sheomedim sham haabelim laasot shura leqabbel tanchumin, im yekolim haam lehatchil veligmor apillu pereq echad vaapillu pasuq echad ad shello yaggiu lashshura — yatchilu veyiqreu kol mah sheyyukelu. Veim lav — lo yatchilu im yesh shehut liqro achar kak. Abal im yaabor zeman qeriat shema — yiqreu qeriat shema techilla, kevan sheadayin lo hitchilu bemitzvat tanchumin:
Haomedim bashshura lenachamo, happenimiyyim haroim pene haabel — peturim, vehachitzonim sheenan roim pene haabel — chayyabim:
